title: Dorohedoro
description: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido’s help. In the Hole, that’s a threat.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Caiman and Nikaido hunt for the sorcerer who cursed him with a lizard's head, while Fujita returns to the Hole to avenge Matsumura's death.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: "Cleaners" Shin and Noi get to work in the Hole. Meanwhile, Caiman and Nikaido search for a sorcerer who uses acupuncture to change faces.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Caiman and Nikaido take part in the annual Night of the Living Dead. But before they can finish their mission, Shin and Noi show up to finish them.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: En consults his comrade Turkey, whose magical dolls may identify the "lizard guy." Caiman and Nikaido visit Kasukabe, a professor studying sorcerers.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: In the sorcerers' world, Caiman and Nikaido locate a man with cross eyes, but the trail goes cold when Shin and Noi show up on a mission.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: En's mushroom magic gravely injures Nikaido when she infiltrates his mansion. Dr. Vaux and Professor Kasukabe tell Caiman about Shin's dark past.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Plotting to avenge Matsumura, Fujita joins the Hole Peace Hospital's baseball team: their rival team has his friend's killer Caiman on the roster.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Fearing for Nikaido's safety, Caiman returns to the sorcerers' world alone. The En family begins preparations for the Blue Night Party festivities.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Caiman sneaks into the festival grounds in pursuit of Risu. Meanwhile, En tells Fujita the story of how Shin and Noi became partners.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Nikaido dons a powerful mask to defeat her enemy, only to find the attack was a trap by En. With Tanba's help, Caiman visits one of the Cross-Eyes.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: As a member of the family, Nikaido learns why En needs a sorcerer who can manipulate time. Caiman disguises himself as Tanba's wife to rescue her.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Caiman tries to convince Nikaido to return to the Hole with him, but her contract with En binds her. After the fight, En launches a search for her.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: While Risu tracks down the Cross-Eyes' hideout, Kasukabe's group heads off to find the professor's estranged wife, only to make a gruesome discovery.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The battle heats up as Shin and Noi fight for their lives. Caiman and Nikaido find themselves being followed as they explore a bustling underground city.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ebisu regains her memories after eating En's new product. Meanwhile, Caiman experiences a violent flashback and Kasukabe goes grave-digging in the Hole.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes_data.title: Dorohedoro Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.
